study.question: Does the previous action-permutation loss persist when permutations preserve the action relationship to the supplied task masks, first their auxiliary union and then the complete four-bit signature? This refines the active conditional-action-utility question without changing its frozen information boundary.
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g2-r0078-full_action_replay exactly reproduces g3-r0058-fixed_angle_negative at click AUC 0.6689610675617089. g2-r0078-action_blind_constant gives 0.6433040120460289 (delta -0.0256570555156800); g2-r0078-action_permuted_retrained gives 0.6624208034892454 (delta -0.0065402640724635); g2-r0078-action_permuted_eval_only gives 0.6558015771863462 (delta -0.0131594903753627). These are successful single-seed executions, not independent mechanism replications. Baseline-din gives 0.6555440824200336; the stronger click model has lower auxiliary AUCs than DIN, so click improvement does not establish all-task improvement. The archived loader primary source builds every task mask from historical action tokens (lines383-408,539-541), and incumbent _represent uses only the auxiliary-task union as its explicit mask routing. The earlier all-valid rotation preserves each row action multiset but disrupts code/mask compatibility as well as item/position alignment. Provisional mechanism: part of its loss may reflect disrupting an already supplied feedback partition rather than information beyond the full masks. Preserving union membership and then all four task-mask bits should distinguish these possibilities. The action-to-mask map is known in source; injectivity of its inverse is NOT established because the actual action vocabulary/data are unavailable here. If codes are constant inside every row/signature group, full-signature rotation is exactly identity and supplies no perturbational evidence about extra code information. Earlier blind losses then remain evidence of useful explicit representation under this recipe, not proof of information unavailable in the supplied masks.

nearest_work.difference: Exact unchanged utility control retained as action_full_control.py; all new standalone modules inherit its whole architecture and training-loss surrogate. Only valid historical action-code placement changes. No architectural novelty is asserted.

Earlier half-length rotation packs every valid event together. The new common implementation reproduces that map in all_valid mode and changes the permitted exchange groups to auxiliary union or complete task signature.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules: unchanged full_action_control; an all_valid rotation bridge; auxiliary_union rotation; and task_signature rotation (candidate.py). The three rotation modules differ only in literal ACTION_PERMUTATION_GROUPS and otherwise share exactly one helper. Before every action-dependent computation, derive the four-bit signature from task_masks>0 using their existing label order and select groups 0, the inherited auxiliary union, or the full signature. Sort unique integer (group,position) keys within each row, place invalid slots in bucket16, use integer group counts/exclusive starts and packed ranks, and gather the code at rank+floor(group_count/2) modulo group_count. Only valid action codes are replaced in a new shallow item mapping; padding, target action, every item field and all masks remain byte-identical. No action moves across examples; row/group action multisets remain exact. Both training and evaluation use the same treatment. All-valid output must equal the previous packing/scatter rotation exactly. No source change is made to host loader, scoring, resource contracts or human knowledge. Public source and receipts are the starting point; raw parquet/checkpoint access, actual vocabulary audit, tensor execution and checksum re-verification are unavailable in this proposal jail, so inherited frozen identities are not claimed as freshly reproduced. Completed local verification: study schema and proposal constraints pass; all four modules parse/compile and have allowed imports and matching literal CONFIG/source hashes. Removing only the new action helper/call/mode and module documentation restores the exact incumbent AST. The three intervention modules have identical ASTs after normalizing only their grouping literal; the full control is byte-identical to the accepted ancestor. An independent pure-Python grouped-rotation oracle and integer-index implementation agree on 21530 exhaustive/random synthetic cases, including noncontiguous masks, empty histories, singleton groups, group multisets, invalid-slot preservation, all-valid equivalence and signature-constant identity. These are algorithm/source checks, not execution of the torch implementation; torch is unavailable. Host tensor/backward/data/replay/performance checks remain pending.
predictions: Unchanged full_action_control should replay 0.6689610675617089 under the frozen seed and host determinism. all_valid_bridge must produce exactly the same treated integer inputs as g2-r0078-action_permuted_retrained, and should replay 0.6624208034892454 and its four-task metrics. Any numerical mismatch needs diagnosis before mechanism interpretation; wall time need not match.

If the earlier loss mainly comes from broken auxiliary-mask compatibility, auxiliary_union should recover click AUC toward full relative to all_valid_bridge. This is a directional hypothesis, not an assumed monotonic ordering or improvement guarantee.

If finer feedback identities are fully carried by complete mask signatures within each row, task_signature will change zero valid codes and will replay full exactly. This is an ineffective-intervention finding, not evidence that action-blind models perform equally well or that raw action tokens are globally determined by masks.

If task_signature changes codes on substantial valid support and retraining loses click AUC relative to full, that is provisional support for code-specific alignment utility within mask-equivalent events. It does not prove incremental Bayes information, production causality or superiority of the architecture.

Allocated parameters and initialization/state keys must match. New integer sort/gather overhead can increase prediction latency without quality change; measure full validation wall time, examples/s, batch p50/p95, training/allocated GPU time, examples processed and peak memory. No equal-compute claim is made from matched passes alone.
falsifiers: Failure of unchanged-source or all_valid replay gates, shape/masking/backward/finite-loss tests, group multiset checks, state/parameter equality or CONFIG/protocol identity invalidates the intended causal comparison; retain failed costs and receipts.

No recovery with auxiliary_union despite nontrivial changed support weakens the claim that union-mask incompatibility accounts for the earlier all-valid loss. It does not refute all historical feedback utility.

Equal or better task_signature AUC on nontrivially changed support weakens useful residual code-alignment dependence for this model and recipe. A zero-change signature treatment cannot falsify action utility: it is identity.

A full-signature identity result combined with the large blind loss falsifies the interpretation that the existing ablation/permutation results alone establish information beyond the supplied masks. It does not establish the inverse mapping globally without a vocabulary audit.
Small single-seed AUC changes without paired uncertainty or host-supported repetitions remain provisional; no significance or robust mechanism claim is authorized.
alternative_explanations: Fixed half-group rotations are deterministic and invertible; they do not establish conditional independence or erase all recoverable code/item information.
Smaller groups change fewer codes and shift distances; singleton and code-constant groups receive no effective intervention. Nonmonotone AUC is possible.
Input changes affect both prediction paths and auxiliary-loss/context-surrogate training; this study does not isolate direct click inference from mediated optimization.
One frozen seed and one pass establish a local recipe-specific result. Same-seed replays are not independent repetitions.

The four masks can encode fine feedback distinctions even though the incumbent directly routes only their auxiliary union. Blind underperformance may therefore concern representational accessibility or optimization under one pass, not additional input information.

Group size/composition, recency and target-match distributions interact with the rotation; union/signature cells alter several conditional alignment properties together. Their differences are not additive effect decompositions.

If a complete signature contains multiple vocabulary aliases globally but only one code within every individual history, within-row permutation has no effective support. Do not infer a globally invertible mask/code map.

Exposure filtering and offline delayed feedback visibility are frozen benchmark assumptions. Results do not establish mature-feedback availability in production or advertisement-specific attribution for auxiliary labels.
